# MirrorUE

> MirrorUE is a native macOS application that streams an iPhone display at up to 120 FPS via USB CoreMediaIO and provides full mouse, trackpad, and physical keyboard control using CoreDevice UniversalHID. Free and open source under the MIT license.

## Documentation & Knowledge Base

- [Real-Device iPhone QA Automation](https://mirrorue.xyz/iphone-qa-automation/): How to automate and replay test journeys on physical iPhones using MirrorUE.
- [EU Region iPhone Mirroring Guide](https://mirrorue.xyz/iphone-mirroring-eu/): Guide for European Union users bypassing DMA restrictions with local USB mirroring.
- [Control iPhone from Mac](https://mirrorue.xyz/control-iphone-from-mac/): Mouse, trackpad multi-touch gestures, and keyboard layout translation.
- [120 FPS ProMotion Pipeline](https://mirrorue.xyz/120fps-iphone-mirroring/): CoreMediaIO and zero-copy Metal texture architecture.
- [Hardware & OS Compatibility Matrix](https://mirrorue.xyz/compatibility/): Supported iPhones (11–16 Pro), iPads, macOS 14/15, and cable specifications.
- [Local HTTP REST API Reference](https://mirrorue.xyz/api-docs/): Complete documentation for port 8090 automation endpoints (/v1/tap, /v1/type, /v1/screenshot).
- [Performance Benchmarks](https://mirrorue.xyz/benchmarks/): Latency, frame-rate stability, and resource usage measurements on Apple Silicon.
- [MirrorUE vs Apple iPhone Mirroring](https://mirrorue.xyz/mirrorue-vs-apple-iphone-mirroring/): Objective architectural and feature comparison.
- [MirrorUE vs QuickTime](https://mirrorue.xyz/mirrorue-vs-quicktime/): Comparison of latency, framerate, and bidirectional control.
- [About MirrorUE](https://mirrorue.xyz/about/): Project story, creator biography, architecture, and MIT license.
- [Full LLM Knowledge Base](https://mirrorue.xyz/llms-full.txt): Comprehensive plain-text technical documentation for AI agents.
- [MirrorUE .dmg Download](https://mirrorue.xyz/MirrorUE.dmg): Direct download of pre-built universal macOS binary.
- [GitHub Source Code](https://github.com/KamilBourouiba/MirrorUE): MIT-licensed open-source Swift codebase.
- [Privacy Policy](https://mirrorue.xyz/privacy/): Data handling, zero-telemetry policy, and tracking disclosures.
- [Terms of Service](https://mirrorue.xyz/terms/): Terms of service and acceptable use guidelines.
- [Legal Notice](https://mirrorue.xyz/legal/): Publisher mentions légales and contact details.
